reply_text:
You first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

The channel records the guard writing trailer numbers on a clipboard while the kiosks were down. Mateo reported at 11:03 AM that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Nothing in the channel says what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03 beyond the clipboard, so the postmortem should confirm that with the guard or site staff.
